concepts.gloss_en: "And you shall love" (Deut 6:5) — the commandment-verse invoked in LM 1:210 (fulfilled through faithful business dealing; linked to the aspect of Abraham)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are vocalized identically (וְאָהַבְתָּ), both in LM 1:210, both citing the same verse and Yoma 86a mishnah about making Heaven's name beloved. No homograph or article distinction — same word, same concept. Clean merge.
